items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: I believe he did have a boy. I believe he had a boy. I believe he had a mother named Hattie.

ctx.x: Laura Bass had a daughter by Bolden. Well.
I heard once he had a son. I thought maybe he had a son too. You don't remember Charles Bolden somebody told me Junior. I guess it'd be a young boy. Same name.

Well since you spoke I. I believe he did have a boy. I believe he had a boy. I believe he had a mother named Hattie. That's all I think. I know since you spoke make me think about it. Was Hattie from this neighborhood?
